theorem payloadFreshWitness_cutPosition_shortCapProfile_largeCapInterior_or_C3Sector_of_minimal_u3

The same-side fresh-witness router with the broad `C2` branch eliminated.

Relative to the current `U3ShortCapSaturation` hypothesis, every escaping
fresh witness is now in one of the explicit frontier branches: retained-`C1`
cut-position, an indexed short-cap finite profile, strict large-cap interior,
or the non-Moser `C3` sector.  This theorem does not close any frontier branch;
it removes the unsplit `z ∈ C2` alternative from the payload-level router.

def ShortCapExactCarrierPartition

Exact selected-carrier partition carried by a short-cap fresh witness.

This is a compact name for the already-proved four-point selected-class
partition.  It is used in the active C2 router so downstream short-cap consumers
receive the exact selected carrier, not only the union with the whole short cap.

theorem U5QCriticalTripleClass.t_qpt0n2_t3_qcritical_antipodal_general_incompatibility

General t3 q-critical antipodal `T:QpT0N2` incompatibility.

The q-critical/exact/q-critical antipodal scalar kernel only needs the left
q-critical row, the exact middle chain row, and `t1` in the third q-critical
row.  The auxiliary witnesses in the middle and third rows are irrelevant.
